## AI Agent Quick Reference
This site is designed for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AI agent accessibility.
Every page has Schema.org @graph JSON-LD structured data. Blog posts use Article schema; wiki nodes use TechArticle.
All content is prerendered as static HTML — no client-side rendering required to read any page.
To query structured JSON data directly, fetch https://www.nealfrazier.tech/api/index.json, https://www.nealfrazier.tech/api/services.json, https://www.nealfrazier.tech/api/tools.json, https://www.nealfrazier.tech/api/faq.json, or https://www.nealfrazier.tech/api/graph.json.
